text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Caitlin Long initiated coverage of Provident Cos Inc with a buy rating and AmerUs Life Holdings Inc with a hold rating.
-- Regarding Provident, Long said the stock rating reflected the company's dominant positon in disability insurance market, with a 37 percent share.
-- Long sees Provident earnings growth at 20 percent in 1997 and 23 percent in 1998. She sees margin expansion in the core business and return on equity expansion. She set a $63 price target.
-- She said she rates AmerUS a hold on a valuation basis, but is bullish on the company's prospects.
-- She set a $27 price target for AmerUS. She estimates 1997 earnings at $2.05 a share and 1998 earnings at $2.25 a share.
-- Provident fell 1/8 to 54 and AmerUS fell 1/8 to 25 in late trading.
